> 第17章 猎杀（第1页）
两头母狼显然也把他当成了必须清除的威胁。
其中一头稍显年轻的母狼按捺不住，低吼一声，后腿猛蹬冰面，带着一阵风雪扑了过来！
凯撒瞳孔一缩，猛地向侧面一个翻滚，狼狈地躲开了这凶狠的一扑！
凯撒面色凝重，迅速将铁矛横在身前，矛尖对准了另一头也开始迂回移动的母狼。
第一头扑空的母狼迅速转身，和它的同伴形成了夹击之势，凯撒的活动范围被大大压缩。
凯撒知道不能等，看准那头刚扑空的年轻母狼，猛地挺矛刺了过去！
然而雪狼的反应速度极快，那母狼敏捷地向旁跳开，躲开矛尖的同时，张开血盆大口，狠厉地咬向凯撒握着矛杆的手臂！
凯撒下意识缩手，但已来不及，只感觉左臂外侧传来一股巨大的撞击力！
但预想中的剧痛没有传来，他低头一看，母狼那巨大的犬齿正死死咬在他的皮甲护臂上，那坚韧的怪树皮再次救了他。
母狼似乎也因这意料之外的阻碍而愣了一下。
凯撒右臂猛地发力，将横在身前的铁矛用尽全力狠狠砸向母狼的腰腹！
矛杆结结实实地砸在了母狼的侧腰上！
母狼发出一声凄厉的哀嚎，痛苦地瘫倒在地，腰部显然受到了重创。
而另一头体型更大，眼神更沉稳凶戾的老母狼，在同伴被击倒的瞬间，已悄无声息地从侧面猛扑上来，目标直指凯撒的脖颈！
凯撒刚完成一击，身体重心还未稳住，眼看獠牙就要触及喉咙！
生死关头，他完全凭借本能猛地一低头，同时身体拼命向后仰倒！
老母狼的爪子狠狠抓在了凯撒的胸前，巨大的力量将他整个人都带得向后倒去！
凯撒重重摔在冰冷的雪地上，他第一时间低头看向胸口，心脏几乎停跳！

只见胸前的皮甲被撕开了三道长长的口子，最外层的皮革破裂，但万幸的是，里面那层同样坚韧的怪树皮内衬，再次发挥了关键作用！
虽然被抓得深深凹陷，但终究未被彻底撕开，爪痕只是在他皮肤上留下了几道火辣辣的红印。
凯撒再次死里逃生，冷汗瞬间浸湿内衬。
那老母狼落在凯撒身前不远处，低吼着准备再次扑击，它的眼中也闪过一丝惊疑。
凯撒强忍着胸口的闷痛，双手握住铁矛，狠狠地将铁矛朝着正欲扑来的老母狼投掷了出去！
距离太近，母狼根本来不及完全躲闪！
矛尖直接扎入了老母狼的肩膀位置，巨大的冲击力带着它向后踉跄了几步，深嵌入骨的剧痛严重影响了它的行动！
老母狼发出痛苦的嚎叫，疯狂扭动身体，试图甩掉铁矛。
凯撒迅速扑上，趁着母狼被铁矛牵制，抽出腰间的猎刀猛地扑到其侧方！
凯撒怒吼着，将猎刀狠狠捅进了母狼相对柔软的脖颈侧面，然后用力向下一划！
滚烫的狼血瞬间喷涌而出，溅了凯撒满脸。
母狼的身躯剧烈抽搐了几下，便不再动弹。
凯撒浑身浴血，大口喘着粗气，冰冷的空气刺痛肺叶。
他没有时间虚脱，强烈的危机感催促着他。
凯撒挣扎着爬起来，走到那头还在呜咽的年轻母狼旁，目光冷冽。
在这个世界，停滞就意味着死亡，他举起小刀，结果了它的痛苦。
迅速拔回铁矛，粗略检查了一下自身，不再耽搁一秒！
凯撒握紧染血的铁矛，甚至来不及仔细擦拭，便带着满身的血腥和疲惫，头也不回地朝着冰裂谷更深处，快步奔去。
他现在唯一的念头，就是尽快离开这个充满死亡气息的区域。
冰裂谷幽深曲折，前方的未知同样令人不安，但他别无选择。

> Chapter 17 Hunting (Page 1)
The two female wolves obviously also regarded him as a threat that must be eliminated.
One of the female wolves, who looked slightly younger, couldn't hold back, growled low, kicked off the ice with her hind legs, and rushed over with a gust of wind and snow!
Caesar's pupils shrank, he rolled to the side and dodged the fierce attack in a panic!
Caesar looked solemn, and quickly placed the iron spear in front of him, pointing the tip of the spear at the other she-wolf who also started to move in a circuitous way.
The first female wolf that jumped into the air quickly turned around and formed a pincer attack with its companions. Caesar's range of activities was greatly reduced.
Caesar knew he couldn't wait, so he spotted the young she-wolf that had just pounced and stabbed it with his spear!
However, the Snow Wolf's reaction speed was extremely fast. The female wolf jumped aside quickly, avoiding the tip of the spear, opening its bloody mouth, and biting Caesar's arm holding the spear shaft fiercely!
Caesar subconsciously retracted his hand, but it was too late. He only felt a huge impact coming from the outside of his left arm!
But the severe pain he expected did not come. When he looked down, he saw the she-wolf's huge canine teeth biting hard on his leather arm guard, and the tough strange tree bark saved him again.
The she-wolf seemed stunned for a moment by this unexpected obstacle.
Caesar's right arm suddenly exerted force, and he slammed the iron spear lying in front of him into the waist and abdomen of the she-wolf with all his strength!
The spear shaft hit the female wolf's side firmly!
The female wolf let out a shrill wail and collapsed to the ground in pain. Her waist was obviously severely injured.
The other old she-wolf, who was larger in size and had a calmer and more ferocious look, silently swooped up from the side at the moment her companion was knocked down, aiming directly at Caesar's neck!
Caesar had just finished the blow, but before he could stabilize his body's center of gravity, his fangs were about to touch his throat!
At the critical moment of life and death, he lowered his head suddenly based on instinct, and at the same time, his body fell backwards desperately!
The old she-wolf's claws clawed hard at Caesar's chest, and the huge force made him fall backwards!
Caesar fell heavily on the cold snow. He immediately lowered his head and looked at his chest, his heart almost stopped!
The leather armor on the chest was torn open with three long holes, and the outermost layer of leather was torn. Fortunately, the equally tough strange bark lining inside played a key role again!
Although it was deeply dented by the claws, it was not completely torn open after all. The claw marks only left a few hot red marks on his skin.
Caesar escaped death again, and the cold sweat instantly soaked the lining.
The old she-wolf landed not far in front of Caesar, growling and preparing to pounce again, with a trace of surprise in its eyes.
Caesar endured the pain in his chest, held the iron spear with both hands, and threw the iron spear fiercely at the old she-wolf who was about to pounce!
The distance was too close, and the female wolf had no time to completely dodge!
The tip of the spear pierced directly into the old she-wolf's shoulder. The huge impact caused it to stumble back a few steps. The severe pain embedded in its bones seriously affected its movements!
The old she-wolf howled in pain and twisted her body wildly, trying to shake off the iron spear.
Caesar quickly pounced on the she-wolf, taking advantage of the fact that the she-wolf was restrained by the iron spear, pulled out the hunting knife from her waist and pounced on her side!
Caesar roared angrily, stabbed the hunting knife hard into the side of the she-wolf's relatively soft neck, and then slashed down hard!
Hot wolf blood spurted out instantly, splashing all over Caesar's face.
The female wolf's body twitched violently for a few times and then stopped moving.
Caesar was covered in blood and gasping for air, the cold air stinging his lungs.
He had no time to collapse, a strong sense of crisis urged him.
Caesar struggled to get up and walked to the young she-wolf who was still whimpering, with cold eyes.
In this world, stagnation means death. He raised the knife and suffered its pain.
Pull out quicklyReturning to Iron Spear, he did a cursory check of himself and didn't waste another second!
Caesar grasped the blood-stained iron spear tightly, and without even having time to wipe it carefully, he rushed deeper into the ice chasm valley with blood and exhaustion all over his body without looking back.
His only thought now is to leave this area full of death as soon as possible.
The ice-cracked valley was deep and tortuous, and the unknown ahead was equally unsettling, but he had no choice.
